title: Request Gatekeeper flow for enterprise admin & access ops
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: We receive a high volume of non-bug admin & access requests from enterprise customers (RBAC role changes, SSO/SAML configuration, SCIM provisioning, org policy exceptions). Currently intake is ad-hoc across support, solutions, and sales which causes delayed responses, inconsistent prioritization, and duplicated engineering work.

Goal: Design a lightweight "Request Gatekeeper" intake + triage flow that centralizes metadata capture, applies a transparent prioritization matrix, and routes requests to the correct track (self-serve docs, solutions engineering, engineering queue, or security review). The flow must be fast to operate by support/SEs, auditable for compliance, and measurable with clear SLAs.

Proposed solution (high level):
- Single intake form (hosted in Zendesk + mirrored Confluence template) that captures required metadata and auto-calculates a priority score.
- Triage rules engine (initially run by PM + SE rotation) that maps score ranges to routing buckets: Docs/Edit (low), SE Assisted (medium), Eng Backlog (high), Immediate Escalation (critical).
- Standard operating playbooks per bucket with checklists (security review, customer comms, rollout notes).
- Decision checklist for RBAC vs SCIM vs SSO to ensure we capture dependencies (e.g., SCIM provisioning requires SCIM connector enabled + SCIM mapping file).
- Telemetry: track time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, re-open rate, number of escalations to Eng, and revenue-weighted SLA compliance.

Scope (what this ticket covers):
- Define intake form fields and scoring algorithm.
- Document routing rules and bucket playbooks.
- Create a one-page Confluence playbook and a Zendesk ticket template.
- Define metrics, SLAs, and dashboard queries.

Out of scope for this ticket: implementing automated rules engine in the platform (follow-up ENG epic), UI changes to Console, changes to prod RBAC enforcement logic.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Intake form (Zendesk + Confluence template) exists and captures all fields listed in intake_form_fields.
2) Priority score algorithm documented and examples for 6 real legacy requests provided.
3) Routing rules documented with at least 4 playbooks (Docs/Edit, SE Assisted, Eng Backlog, Immediate Escalation).
4) Runbook for SEs/support outlining who to contact for security review and how to attach evidence.
5) Dashboard queries defined (Prometheus/Metabase or internal dashboard) for: time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, escalations, SLA compliance.
6) Stakeholder sign-off from Support Manager, Solutions Eng lead, Security, and two enterprise customer success managers.
intake_form_fields:
Suggested required fields: requester name + email, customer org name, customer tier/revenue bracket, affected feature (RBAC | SSO | SCIM | Org Policy | Other), short summary, detailed steps or config snippets, error logs or screenshots, expected outcome, proposed change (if applicable), is this blocking production? (Y/N), business impact description, number of affected users, earliest possible start date, desired completion date, attach: config files (SAML metadata, SCIM mapping CSV), contact for technical followup, previous ticket IDs (if any). Optional: GDPR/data residency notes, PCI/regulated workload.

Auto-derived fields: customer_impact_score (based on tier + blocking flag), security_surface_flag (true if request touches identity or encryption), repeat_request_flag (true if similar requests exist), estimated_effort_bucket (quick/medium/complex assigned by SE during triage).
prioritization_rubric:
Scoring (0-10 composite):
- Customer impact (0-4): blocking production=4, significant loss of functionality=3, minor annoyance=1-2, cosmetic=0.
- Revenue/tier multiplier (x1.5 for enterprise ARR > $250k; x1.25 for $50k-$250k; x1 otherwise).
- Security/compliance factor (+2 if requires security review or affects audit logs).
- Frequency/scale (0-2): affects >1000 users=2, >100 users=1, <100=0.
- Effort/complexity penalty (-0 for quick, -1 medium, -2 complex) to bias towards quick wins but still flag complex high-impact.

Routing thresholds: 
- 0-2 = Docs/Edit (low)
- 3-5 = SE Assisted (mid)
- 6-8 = Eng Backlog (high)
- 9-10+ = Immediate Escalation (critical)

Examples and worked sample calculations are required in the playbook.
routing_rules:
Initial routing (manual automated via Zendesk macros):
- Docs/Edit: Assign to Knowledge Mgmt triage queue; target TTR (time-to-resolution) 10 business days.
- SE Assisted: Assign to Solutions Engineering queue; SE to respond within 2 business days and deliver workaround or plan.
- Eng Backlog: Create ENG issue with PM tag; target SLAs: ack in 2 business days, ETA for work during next sprint planning.
- Immediate Escalation: Notify on-call Eng lead + Security & AE; target immediate phone sync and 24-72h hotfix window depending on severity.

Routing overrides: Customer request from enterprise legal/regulatory flagged requires security approval before any prod changes. Requests modifying RBAC defaults or audit logging require security and compliance sign-off. SCIM connector changes must include a test plan and rollback steps.
follow_up_tasks:
- Create Zendesk ticket template and test with 5 recent tickets (owner: Support Manager).
- Write Confluence one-pager and training slide deck for SE rotation (owner: PM).
- Build Metabase dashboard queries for SLA metrics (owner: Analytics).
- Draft standard email templates for status updates per bucket (owner: Customer Success).
- Kick off ENG bug/feature epic for automation of rules engine (owner: Eng PM; dependency ENG-4210).
- Schedule triage rotation calendar and handoff checklist (owner: Solutions Eng Lead).
- Plan security review checklist and required evidence artifacts (owner: Security).
metrics:
Primary metrics: time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, percent of requests routed to Eng, percent of escalations labeled security, SLA attainment by revenue tier, re-open rate within 30 days. Secondary: average priority score, median engineering effort for Eng-routed requests.

Targets (initial): time-to-first-response 2 business days (90%+), time-to-resolution Docs/Edit 10 business days (80%+), Eng ack within 2 business days (95%+), reduction in duplicate Eng requests by 30% within first quarter after rollout.

2026-03-10 Liam O'Connor (Assignee): Drafted prioritization rubric and routing thresholds. Uploaded Confluence template (link in notes). Next: validate sample scoring on 6 tickets with Support and SEs week of 2026-03-15.
